description: Curated signup failure modes + append-only observations. Agents pull tips via get_signup_tips(); do not dump this whole file into the task prompt.

symptoms: Sign Up / Create account / Continue click does nothing
same submit button clicked 2+ times with no navigation
modes.tip: After two failed submits, stop clicking. Read the form for red validation text, required empty fields, unchecked terms, or a disabled button (aria-disabled / opacity). Fix the field, then submit once.

symptoms: element index exists but click has no effect
modes.tip: Dismiss cookie/consent/newsletter overlays first, then retry the signup control. Prefer Accept / Close over leaving the modal open.
Call solve_captcha() at most twice. If it still fails, call report_blocked(captcha_unsolved). Do not wait-loop or click the challenge yourself.
Never invent OTP digits. Call get_email_code / get_sms_code / get_totp_code and type the exact returned value. If the tool errors, report that — do not guess.
Call mark_email_requested() immediately after clicking Send code / Verify email / Continue, then call get_email_code or get_email_link once.
Do not invent a new email. Switch to Sign in with the same IDENTITY password, or call report_blocked(unknown) with detail email_already_used.

symptoms: only Continue with Google / GitHub / SSO
modes.tip: Prefer email/password. Look for 'Sign up with email' / 'Continue with email'. If truly SSO-only, call report_blocked(sso_only).

symptoms: product tour / checklist after account created
Skip / Maybe later / Not now available
modes.tip: Once the account exists, dismiss tours with Skip / Not now and stop when an account menu, dashboard, or Logout is visible.

symptoms: login.* subdomain treated as product host
email alias looks wrong for the product
redirected to IdP and lost signup context
modes.tip: Stay on the product signup flow. Use the IDENTITY email already provided — do not derive a new alias from the current subdomain.

symptoms: waiting on get_email_link for a long time
modes.tip: After mark_email_requested(), call get_email_link once and navigate to the returned URL. Do not interleave other long actions while waiting.

symptoms: Sign Up button visible but repeated clicks fail
modes.tip: Check terms checkbox and required fields. If Sign Up stays inert after a fix attempt, inspect validation text once — do not spam evaluate() clicks.

observations.symptom: submit does nothing / Sign Up click loop
observations.detail: BB developer proxies+captcha; filled form; 10 steps; never called get_signup_tips; not_signed_in
